text: Three launches. Three failures. Money for only one more try.
Twenty oh six. SpaceX's first rocket lifts off.
Thirty seconds later, it's on fire.
Twenty oh seven. It reaches space. Then the second stage spins out of control.
August twenty oh eight. The stages collide. Everything is lost.
Musk had money for three attempts. And Tesla was nearly broke too.
Eight weeks later, one last rocket stands on the pad. If it fails, it's all over.
The first privately built liquid-fueled rocket to reach orbit. Months later, NASA signed a one point six billion dollar contract.
EVERY SpaceX rocket TODAY... started with THAT, FOURTH, TRY.
